title: Integral twist equivalences descend to rationalization
statement: Let $\ell$ be a prime and $S$ be a scheme on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be a finite extension with uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and let $\mathcal C=D^b_c(S,\mathcal O_E)$ be the $\mathcal O_E$-linear triangulated category of [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi]. Suppose $U,V:\mathcal C\to\mathcal C$ are exact [def-weil-triangulated-category] $\mathcal O_E$-linear [def-weil-linear-functor] functors equipped with natural inverse isomorphisms $VU\cong\operatorname{id}_{\mathcal C}$ and $UV\cong\operatorname{id}_{\mathcal C}$. Then $U$ and $V$ act on the scalar localization $\mathcal C[1/\varpi_E]$ defined in [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi] by $U(f\otimes a)=U(f)\otimes a$ and $V(f\otimes a)=V(f)\otimes a$, and these induced functors are exact inverse equivalences. In particular, if $m\in\mathbf Z$ and $U(C)=C(m)$ and $V(C)=C(-m)$ are the inverse integral twist functors of [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], their induced functors are mutually inverse twists on $D^b_c(S,E)$.
